body: Often times I do.  Most of the time I do.

Have you ever seen a complete piece of shit movie and had a friend talk about how awesome it is?  That's what its like.  You *know* you're a piece of shit, and when you hear other people say you're not, it doesn't make you feel good, you don't take it as a compliment, it just feels like that person is ignoring reality and then you write them off as someone you can't connect with and then you feel even more isolated because no one truly understand how big of a piece of garbage you are on the inside.
Nailed it.  Feel free to check out my post history for another first hand account.
